import pytest
import my_memviz


def test_graph_initial_state():
    g = my_memviz.Graph()
    assert g.nodes == []
    assert g.edges == []
    assert g.total_saved_memory_bytes == 0


def test_add_node_accumulates_memory():
    g = my_memviz.Graph()
    node1 = my_memviz.GraphNode(
        node_id=0,
        op_type="conv",
        output_shape=[1, 64, 32, 32],
        saved_memory_bytes=1024,
    )
    node2 = my_memviz.GraphNode(
        node_id=1,
        op_type="relu",
        output_shape=[1, 64, 32, 32],
        saved_memory_bytes=2048,
    )
    g.add_node(node1)
    assert g.total_saved_memory_bytes == 1024
    assert len(g.nodes) == 1
    assert g.nodes[0] is node1
    g.add_node(node2)
    assert g.total_saved_memory_bytes == 3072
    assert len(g.nodes) == 2
    assert g.nodes[1] is node2


def test_add_edge_stores_from_to():
    g = my_memviz.Graph()
    g.add_edge(0, 1)
    g.add_edge(1, 2)
    assert len(g.edges) == 2
    assert g.edges[0] == {"from": 0, "to": 1}
    assert g.edges[1] == {"from": 1, "to": 2}


def test_graph_node_still_works():
    node = my_memviz.GraphNode(
        node_id=5,
        op_type="matmul",
        output_shape=[2, 2],
    )
    assert node.node_id == 5
    assert node.op_type == "matmul"
    assert node.output_shape == [2, 2]
    assert node.saved_tensors == []
    assert node.saved_memory_bytes == 0


def test_format_bytes_still_works():
    assert my_memviz.format_bytes(0) == "0"
    assert my_memviz.format_bytes(1000) == "1,000"
    assert my_memviz.format_bytes(1234567) == "1,234,567"
